channel.title: freecritter.xyz
channel.description: AI, Bitcoin, and emerging financial technology. Lightning economics and Bitcoin treasury strategy.

item.title: The exit right: why a centralizing Lightning still cannot take your Bitcoin
item.description: Lightning is centralizing and the data is not subtle. It still cannot seize your Bitcoin or trap it. The reason is one property no dominant node can strip: you can always leave, alone, without anyone's permission.

item.title: Can You Actually Earn on Lightning? With Chris Ritter | SLP739
item.description: A conversation on the Stephan Livera Podcast about Lightning Network economics: where routing yield actually comes from, the network's centralization trends, node security, and the growth of Lightning payments.

item.title: The digital credit threshold: who actually gets to run the Saylor playbook
item.description: Every Bitcoin treasury is told to do what Saylor does. For most of them the math says they can't. The playbook needs a premium and a scale they don't have.

item.title: The third custody model: keep the keys, outsource the operations
item.description: Finance gave you two choices: hand your keys to a custodian, or run everything yourself. Lightning adds a third. You keep the keys, a professional runs the node, and you can leave in two weeks.

item.title: The property filter: why Lightning, not staking or lending
item.description: Bitcoin has six core properties worth protecting. Every yield mechanism I tested surrenders at least one. Routing on Lightning surrenders none. Here is the test.

item.title: Same-asset unity: one asset from capital to revenue
item.description: Every other yield has a seam, where you swap assets or hand over custody. Routing on Lightning has none. The capital, the medium, and the revenue are one and the same bitcoin.

item.title: Static capital bias and the Lightning return illusion
item.description: An 8 basis point fee looks like nothing, until you see that the capital behind it turns over about 65 times a year. The fee is small. The return is not.

item.title: Native Yield: the third category of Bitcoin treasury returns
item.description: Most public companies holding Bitcoin earn nothing on it. The playbook they are told to copy only works for a handful. There is a third category.
